0022600116.text: The Oklahoma City Thunder (2-0, first in the Northwest and third in the West) host the LA Clippers (1-1, one game back in the Pacific and seventh in the West) in the Thunder's third game of the 2026-27 season, with Oklahoma City on a two-game winning streak and 1-0 at home. Out for the Thunder are Nikola Topic (back surgery), Otega Oweh (Achilles surgery), and Thomas Sorber (knee surgery), while the Clippers are without Bradley Beal (knee inflammation), Jordan Miller (shoulder surgery), Max Strus (plantar fasciitis), and Yanic Konan Niederhauser (foot surgery). The teams have not played each other yet in 2026-27, but the Thunder won the 2025-26 season series 3-0, including a 128-110 win in Los Angeles on April 8, 2026.
